title: Petra and the Choir
author: Bram Vane
blurb: Lior Coldharbour, a debt-bound temple scribe, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
